- Recognition: if PO posts before 6/10 and invoice is dated in June, we can recognize the full subscription revenue in Q3. If PO slips beyond 6/10 close we may need to push recognition to next period.
- Invoice cadence: we can accept a single upfront invoice or two-part (50% upfront / 50% on go-live). Net 30 is standard; we can accept Net 45 only with an approved exception.

Request to Ben: confirm whether Acme prefers 1x invoice or split billing. If they prefer split, we need a signed commitment that ties milestone dates to billing events (we can use the MOP milestones).

I’m attaching the consolidated forecast view I pulled: q3-forecast-rollup.pdf — it shows the delta if Acme slips a week.

If we see PO ETA of 6/7 we should be fine; anything later we escalate to revenue leadership for a recognition exception.
